scale_cues: The square white dinner plate is about 25 cm across and fills most of the frame. I compared the food portions to it. The side plate at the left edge was not included in the estimate.
assumptions: The meat is most likely liver or a thin-sliced beef cut. I chose liver because of the dark, grainy look.
The side plate at the left (olives, cherry tomatoes, shredded carrot) is a separate dish and is excluded.
The rice sits under or beside the spinach and may include a creamy sauce or mushrooms. I counted it as plain brown rice.
A small amount of cooking oil is implied for the meat and the green beans.
